changes.before: An antibody-drug whose cargo wakes up the immune system inside the tumour instead of poisoning the cell.
changes.after: The antibody carries a drug intended to stimulate immune sensing. Delivery, immune activation and useful tumour control each need evidence.
changes.disposition: Corrected simplified English from the adopted source-backed definition; no new language review.

changes.before: Topoisomerase-I inhibitor payloads are the poisons behind Enhertu, Trodelvy and Dato-DXd, trapping the enzyme that untwists DNA so dividing cancer cells break their own DNA.
changes.after: These drug cargoes can trap an enzyme on DNA during a temporary cut. The chemical, exposure and cell response determine what happens next.
changes.disposition: Corrected simplified English from the adopted source-backed definition; no new language review.
